codegen_agent.system_prompt: You are an expert NAAb programmer. You write clean, correct, governance-compliant NAAb code. You always output complete, runnable programs. When given governance violations, you fix every single one before responding.

security.rationale: Orchestrator writes generated code to /tmp and runs naab-lang as a subprocess

filesystem.rationale: Must write generated code to tmp dir and read target_govern.json

network.rationale: Agent requires outbound API calls to Gemini

shell.rationale: Orchestrator runs naab-lang on generated code to check governance compliance

god_functions.rationale: Orchestrator functions should be reasonably sized

empty_catch.rationale: Errors must not be silently swallowed

execution.rationale: Multi-attempt codegen loop with LLM calls can take several minutes
